Define the compound set as CHEMBL1173655 plus all its salts: start from molecule_dictionary where chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1173655' as the parent, then join molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno = parent.molregno to get child salts, and include the parent row itself. From this compound set, retrieve activity provenance via the FAQ path: join compound_records on molregno, docs on doc_id, activities on record_id, assays on assay_id, and target_dictionary on tid. Filter to standard_type = 'IC50', standard_units = 'nM', and target chembl_id = 'CHEMBL203'. For pubmed_id_or_doi, prefer docs.pubmed_id when present, otherwise use docs.doi. Return compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Sort by all returned columns in listed order. No row limit.
